info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Agreement Management API
info.description: The Customer Agreement Management API enables businesses to update and manage customer agreements efficiently. With this API, users can modify existing agreements to reflect changes in terms or customer details. It is designed for financial institutions and customer service teams seeking to streamline the agreement management process. Typical use cases include adjusting terms due to customer requests or compliance updates, ensuring all agreements remain current and accurate.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of a customer agreement identified by CUST-100045. It must contain the necessary fields that reflect the modifications to be made to the existing agreement. Ensure that all required fields are included to process the update successfully.
